control.note: prompt_template is document-scoped content, not a portable hyperparameter -- each arm's prompt was tuned against its own document, so neither is a fair frozen value. It is held constant at the fresh arm's value and excluded from the comparison. Deltas below are attributable to compared_dimensions only. fresh_seeded_from_profile records whether the FRESH arm's iteration 1 was derived from this document's profile; the FROZEN arm never is.
